items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I got in on Hank’s coattail.

ctx.x: You know there’s been so many stories about these kinds of things where people, Al Grey who happened to be a club when the Basie band was there and their trombone player was sick and the guy said, “get your horn” and he ran, and it’s just little amazing coincidences that helped people.

Well I mean those things work. And I mean that’s, as time goes by, now I’m starting to get a footing, and people say, hey, the kid can play, he speaks kind of weird but he can play, so we’ll hire him. And now, that’s how I got into the studio business. You know what I mean by the studio — playing jingles and record dates and things like that. There was a big band jingle going on, I forget what it was, for what product. But Hank Jones was supposed to be there and for some reason Hank was sick or something and…
That’s where that reading too, comes in important, because you can’t just walk into a studio.
